descriptions.text: Enchanted Mongoliensis Saddle. Adjusted to fit Cat species. Magically affixes itself to the dreaded Mongoliensis, turning everyone's favorite murder chicken into a mount. Riders in the saddle are afforded the following bonuses: +15% to all offensive spell damage. Anti-Piercing Resistance. In addition, the saddle gives the following bonus to the attached Mongoliensis: +20% Constitution. +20% melee damage while saddle is occupied.

recap.text: Donut's platinum fan box opens on a blue and red saddle, tassel-covered and garish as something on a horse in a Fourth of July parade. After a curly fry and a word from Donut, Mongo lets Carl set it on his back, and it clicks into place. In the crafting room, Donut leaps on and a translucent strap wraps her waist, but Mongo bucks her off several times and finally tosses her onto Mordecai's alchemy table.

Carl is sewing the four-leaf-clover patch onto his jacket when Donut shows him Legendary Steed, a saddle upgrade that lets her add a cart to Mongo, adds no weight, and leaves him able to jump. Mongo is in the garage helping Prepotente supervise the emergency gremlins. Donut asks about the missile cart, and Carl says it is spoken for, but if it survives, it is a good idea. Then Donut sees that his patch is not straight.

beats.headline: Our fans got us a saddle
beats.text: Donut's platinum fan box, where viewers pay a credit to vote, opens on a saddle, and she thanks everybody. It is blue and red, tassel-covered and obscenely garish, like something on a horse in a Fourth of July parade. Mordecai calls it a really good prize, but he has never seen anybody ride one. Carl likes the constitution and not the idea of Donut up there while Mongo fights; Mordecai tells her to practise jumping out of the saddle when he attacks. It is just a seat, a pommel and tassels. After a curly fry and a word from Donut, Mongo lets Carl set it on his back, and it clicks into place, the same sound a table makes in the crafting room.
beats.gist: Donut's fan box opens on a garish saddle, and Mongo, given a curly fry, lets Carl fit it.

beats.headline: A psychic bond
beats.text: In the crafting room, after ten minutes of coaxing, Donut leaps onto the saddle and a translucent strap wraps around her waist. Mongo bucks like a bronco. The strap's hold has a limit, and she is thrown several times. When he calms down he stands there miserable. How will she control him with no reins, Carl asks. She and Mongo have a psychic bond, she says, and Mongo tosses her halfway across the room onto Mordecai's alchemy table, then rolls onto his back trying to dislodge the saddle. On the ochre line platform her two Clockwork Mongos have little saddles on them too.
beats.gist: Donut, thrown repeatedly by the bucking Mongo, insists their psychic bond will control him without reins.

beats.headline: Legendary Steed
beats.text: Carl is sewing the four-leaf-clover patch onto his jacket when Donut calls him over: she has an upgrade for Mongo's saddle, and it is called Legendary Steed. It lets her add a cart to him, it adds no weight, and he can still jump. Mongo is in the garage helping Prepotente supervise the emergency gremlins. Can they use the missile cart, she asks. That one is already spoken for, Carl says, but if it survives, it is a good idea. Then Donut sees that his patch is not straight.
beats.gist: Donut's Legendary Steed upgrade lets her add a weightless cart to Mongo's saddle.
